title: Global Mobility Career Guide
subtitle: Strategies to Build an International Career and Succeed Across Borders

sections.title: Why Global Mobility Matters in Today’s Career Landscape

blocks.text: In a world where companies like McKinsey, Amazon, and JP Morgan hire globally, **geography should not limit ambition.** Global mobility allows you to:

blocks.label: Reflection
blocks.text: Why do you want a global career—money, exposure, family relocation, or impact?
Without clarity, international moves feel random. Define:

items: **Destination industries:** Consulting in UK, Finance in US, Tech in Canada.
**Family fit:** Schooling, culture, cost of living.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write your 5-year international career vision.
Each geography has unique pros/cons:

items: **Middle East:** Tax-free income, high expat population.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: List 2 countries aligned with your career + lifestyle goals.
Visa is the gatekeeper.

blocks.label: Check before you plan
blocks.text: Visa and immigration rules change often. Confirm the current requirements on the official government website for each country.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Research 1 visa for your target country and note eligibility.
Global employers prefer portable skills:

items: **Tech:** AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Data Analytics.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write 1 certification you’ll pursue this year for global relevance.
Your international break often comes through **networks.**

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Send 1 LinkedIn message to an alum in your target geography.

sections.title: Crafting a Globally Relevant Resume & LinkedIn

blocks.text: Global resumes differ:

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Rewrite 1 resume bullet in globally relevant format.
Cultural nuances matter:

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Practice “Tell me about yourself” in 2 different cultural styles.
Beyond job offer, success requires planning:

items: Budget: Salary vs cost of living.
Culture: Adapt to food, language, etiquette.

blocks.label: Checklist
blocks.text: List top 3 relocation worries you’d have.

sections.title: Thriving in Global Teams & Remote Work

blocks.text: Multicultural teams bring innovation—but also friction. Success requires:

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write 1 strategy to manage collaboration with teams across 3 time zones.

sections.title: From India to a UK consulting role

blocks.text: Ananya, a business school graduate in India, targeted consulting roles in the UK. She prepared cases with London-based alumni, rewrote her resume in UK style, and joined a firm that sponsored her Skilled Worker visa.

sections.title: From Brazil to a US product role

blocks.text: Lucas from Brazil did an MBA in the US. He networked with recruiters at tech companies, showcased his international projects, and secured a product manager role with H-1B sponsorship.

blocks.label: Lesson
blocks.text: Global careers = skill + visa strategy + networking.

items: Pitfalls: Assuming degree = job, ignoring visas, weak networks.
